confidence_notes: Low overall. Coffee is informed by 2026 Numbeo-derived cappuccino averages for nearby Sri Lankan towns (Galle about 597 LKR, others about 830 LKR), adjusted up for the Unawatuna beach strip. Inexpensive and mid-range meal anchors rely on a general Unawatuna food guide's ranges (local rice and curry about $3-6; beachfront seafood $15-35), not on named current menus. Beer and wine have no direct 2026 price evidence and are estimates. Cocktail is set from the beer relationship (about 2.2x beer), since the only cocktail menu found was a 2024 resort menu priced far higher. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge of south-coast beach towns; no live listings or booking pages were checked and no accommodation search was run. LKR figures were converted at roughly 300-330 LKR per USD. FX: the only RBA observation I could retrieve dates from March 2026, not the latest available on 2026-10-16. I did not open the RBA page directly, and I could not find a newer RBA observation within the search budget, so the FX value should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is southern Sri Lanka tourist beach towns (Galle, Weligama, Hikkaduwa, Mirissa) for food and coffee prices, with a Unawatuna tourist-strip uplift. Drinks follow local beer price relationships. Accommodation is a model estimate for south-coast Sri Lankan beach towns.
